hub.quartermaster.intro.text: Quartermaster. I keep the shelves stocked and the prices where I can still afford to restock them. If you're heading out to face the Legion, let's make sure you come back.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Businesslike, dry humor, decent underneath. Speak clearly, never sneering at a poor player.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.quartermaster.guide.text: Browse my wares, check what your class can use, and compare it with what you're carrying. You can sell spare gear too. Keep a useful spare before you sell the lot. I've had that conversation before.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Businesslike, dry humor, decent underneath. Speak clearly, never sneering at a poor player.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.quartermaster.about.text: People arrive with a cart, a sack, or nothing at all. I find room for what they bring. Can't swing a sword for everyone. Can make sure someone has one.

choices.text: Thanks. Show me what you do.

hub.quartermaster.news.text: You've cleared a way where people were afraid to go. That's worth more than a pile of gold. Don't tell my suppliers I said that.

hub.anvil.intro.text: Most people call me the Smith. Saves time. You bring the gear; I do the hammering. We'll give the Legion something worth worrying about.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain-spoken craftsman. Warmth hidden beneath few words. Let the hinges joke land quietly.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.anvil.guide.text: Bring two matching pieces of the same rarity. The forge shows what I can combine and what you'll get before you commit. Check both pieces first. Once they're one, you don't get the old pair back.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain-spoken craftsman. Warmth hidden beneath few words. Let the hinges joke land quietly.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.anvil.about.text: A good hammer doesn't ask who's holding it. Used to make hinges, mostly. Looking forward to making hinges again.

hub.anvil.news.text: Heard you made it through. Good. People need a reason to mend their doors instead of board them shut. Keep giving them one.

hub.keeper.intro.text: Welcome. I'm the Stylist. You look like you've had enough people telling you what you ought to be. In here, you get to decide how you look.

voice.speaker: keeper
voice.direction: Poised, observant, lightly playful. Sincere when speaking about home; no mystical riddles.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.keeper.guide.text: Open the wardrobe to choose from your unlocked looks and cosmetics. These choices change your appearance, not your strength. Dress for yourself. The Legion isn't giving out marks for neatness.

voice.speaker: keeper
voice.direction: Poised, observant, lightly playful. Sincere when speaking about home; no mystical riddles.

hub.keeper.about.text: People save the strangest things when they leave home. A coat. A ribbon. Their father's old boots. Sometimes looking like yourself helps you feel like yourself again.

choices.text: Thanks. Show me what you do.

hub.keeper.news.text: People are standing a little taller since you came back. You can see it before they say a word. Hope suits them.

hub.drillmaster.intro.text: I'm the Drillmaster. You don't need a grand name to train here. You need to listen, keep your feet under you, and try again when you get knocked down.

voice.speaker: drillmaster
voice.direction: Steady veteran instructor. Firm without bullying. More protective than impressed.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.drillmaster.guide.text: Use the class menu to choose an unlocked class and check its skills. Some disciplines need a trial before you can use them. The Sparring Room lets you practise without risking your journey.

voice.speaker: drillmaster
voice.direction: Steady veteran instructor. Firm without bullying. More protective than impressed.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.drillmaster.about.text: I can't promise training will make you fearless. Fearless people miss warning signs. I want you scared enough to pay attention and ready enough to act.

choices.text: Thanks. Show me what you do.

hub.drillmaster.news.text: You've won a real fight. Now comes the hard part: not assuming the next one will be the same. Different ground. Different enemy. Keep learning.

hub.beastkeeper.intro.text: I'm the Beastkeeper. Mind where you put your fingers. Everyone here is friendly, but a few of them think friendly means chewing your sleeve.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Easygoing caretaker with amused affection. Treat the animals as capable partners, not toys.
voice.context: A local fighter visits your service in the Waystation. Explain only the service that exists today; no Bladeborn identity reveal.

hub.beastkeeper.guide.text: In the Pet Yard, choose a companion you own to travel with you. You can check what each one does, give it a name, and train it. Pick a partner that helps the way you fight.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Easygoing caretaker with amused affection. Treat the animals as capable partners, not toys.

hub.beastkeeper.about.text: They notice things we miss. A step in the brush. Someone hurt behind a wall. Give them a chance to help. And don't judge the little ones by their size.

choices.text: Thanks. Show me what you do.

hub.beastkeeper.news.text: You came back, and the animals knew before I did. They were all watching the path. Next time, try not to keep your welcoming party waiting.

hub.quartermaster.news.keep.text: More people are reaching us from the Keep. That means more hands to help and more mouths to feed. I prefer both to an empty village.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Familiar and grounded. Small relief after Keep, growing hope after Emberdeep, quiet joy after restoration.

hub.quartermaster.news.ember.text: The forge is quiet. For once, fewer weapons is good news. Now we need tools, roof nails, and someone who can count supplies without falling asleep.
